name: Silly Quail 9
author: 0xnihilism
description: White text input that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translate(-4px, -4px), box-shadow becomes 12px 12px 0 #000. On focus, background-color changes from #fff to #010101, text color changes from #000 to #fff, border-color becomes #d6d9dd.
